world_seed.locale: A vertical cliffside city of bridges, ledges, echo wells, and household terraces.
world_seed.tone: Lyrical civic pressure, intimate debt, and precarious trust.
world_seed.visual_direction: Layered sandstone balconies, brass speaking scales, sealed courier tubes, and wind-torn pledge ribbons.

institutions.name: The Weighhouse
institutions.mandate: Assess the weight-tax due on every witnessed spoken promise.
institutions.decision_rule: Certified echo scales measure wording, witnesses, and duration; disputed vows are reweighed publicly.
institutions.enforced_by: Tax listeners, scale clerks, and bridge gate seals.
institutions.visible_output: Stamped vow slips showing weight, due date, and unpaid balance.

institutions.name: The Unburdened Route
institutions.mandate: Carry unpaid promises between households until they are redeemed, transferred, or broken.
institutions.decision_rule: Routes prioritize promises nearing maturity and cargo that exceeds a household's carrying limit.
institutions.enforced_by: Licensed couriers, route ledgers, and sealed message satchels.
institutions.visible_output: Couriers visibly bearing ribboned promise bundles across cliff bridges.

institutions.name: Court of Echoes
institutions.mandate: Rule whether a promise was fulfilled, amended, coerced, or void.
institutions.decision_rule: Three magistrates compare recorded echoes against witness testimony; ties favor the debtor.
institutions.enforced_by: Court bailiffs and orders recognized by the Weighhouse.
institutions.visible_output: Public echo rulings, void marks, and compelled restitution notices.

institutions.name: Bridge Wardenry
institutions.mandate: Keep cliff crossings safe and restrict passage for delinquent vowweight.
institutions.decision_rule: A bridge closes to a household when unpaid weight exceeds its posted safety bond.
institutions.enforced_by: Warden crews, gate chains, and wind-signal towers.
institutions.visible_output: Open or chained bridges, household passage tags, and safety-bond boards.

state_variables.label: Unpaid vowweight in circulation
state_variables.initial_tension: High after a season of ambitious household bargains.

state_variables.label: Courier route capacity
state_variables.initial_tension: Strained by wind damage and overloaded satchels.

state_variables.label: Bridge access between terraces
state_variables.initial_tension: Uneven, with several debtor districts near closure.

state_variables.label: Credibility of recorded speech
state_variables.initial_tension: Fragile because forged echoes are circulating.

state_variables.label: Household ability to pay vow taxes
state_variables.initial_tension: Low among upper-ledge tenants and seasonal workers.

causal_links.trigger: Balances rise beyond household carrying limits.
causal_links.effect: More promises are assigned to couriers, congesting routes and increasing late delivery.
causal_links.delay: Immediate congestion; severe backlog after several delivery cycles.

causal_links.trigger: Routes remain overloaded or are cut by wind.
causal_links.effect: Late, lost, or tampered promise bundles make recorded speech easier to dispute.
Households delay settlement and demand more witnesses, leaving more taxable promises unresolved.

causal_links.trigger: Households cannot convert goods or labor into vowweight.
causal_links.effect: Tax arrears and transferred promise burdens increase.

causal_links.trigger: A household exceeds the Wardenry safety bond.
causal_links.effect: Wardens restrict crossings, isolating debt-heavy terraces.
causal_links.delay: At the next posted bond review.

causal_links.effect: Restricted trade and work travel reduce household income, worsening ability to settle vows.

stakeholder_groups.name: Upper-Ledge Households
stakeholder_groups.goal: Lower vow taxes and preserve open bridge passage without surrendering family promises.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: They can collectively withhold testimony, labor, and safety-bond payments.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They depend on couriers to move excess promise weight and on bridges for food and work.

stakeholder_groups.name: Licensed Couriers
stakeholder_groups.goal: Raise delivery fees and gain exclusive control over unpaid-promise routes.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: They control custody chains and can prioritize, delay, or reveal promise bundles.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They depend on Weighhouse stamps, safe bridges, and credible echoes to make deliveries enforceable.

stakeholder_groups.name: Weighhouse Clerks
stakeholder_groups.goal: Protect tax collection and the authority of speaking scales.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: They certify weight, deadlines, and whether a spoken promise enters the ledger.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They depend on witnesses, court-recognized recordings, and households remaining able to pay.

stakeholder_groups.name: Terrace Merchants
stakeholder_groups.goal: Keep bridges open and accept promises as trade credit with minimal delay.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: They set exchange discounts for vow slips and fund bridge repairs.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They depend on household liquidity, reliable courier arrivals, and trusted echo records.

premise: In a cliffside city, every spoken promise is taxed by weight, while couriers carry unpaid vows between households.
simulation_objective: Build influence by settling, transferring, contesting, or exploiting promise burdens without collapsing the city's trust and crossings.
economy_focus: Taxable spoken obligations, courier custody, vowweight credit, and bridge-gated trade.
exploration_focus: Vertical terraces, echo chambers, courier routes, closed bridges, and hidden witness networks.
visual_style: Windworn vertical fantasy with brass instruments and luminous echo-script.

gameplay_loops.label: Reweigh, settle, reopen
gameplay_loops.summary: Contest excessive vowweight, assemble witnesses, and settle or amend the result before a bond review closes passage.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Changes unpaid_vowweight and household_liquidity; if balances remain high, activates the unpaid_vowweight-to-bridge_access closure link.

gameplay_loops.label: Custody chain recovery
gameplay_loops.summary: Trace delayed bundles, repair route failures, and expose or contain tampered echoes before disputes spread.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Changes courier_route_capacity and echo_credibility; prolonged overload activates the courier_route_capacity-to-echo_credibility causal link.

gameplay_loops.label: Bonded crossing bargain
gameplay_loops.summary: Convert repair labor, temporary credit, and transferred burdens into enough safety bond to keep a terrace connected.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Changes bridge_access and household_liquidity; restricted crossings activate the bridge_access-to-household_liquidity causal link.

gameplay_loops.label: Sheltered testimony docket
gameplay_loops.summary: Secure vulnerable witnesses, calibrate maturity timing, and test contested recordings in a ruling that may void obligations.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Changes echo_credibility and unpaid_vowweight; credible voids can reduce arrears, while coerced testimony worsens confidence in echoes.

player_entry_points: Carry a late promise bundle whose seal was damaged in a wind crossing.
Petition to reweigh a family vow that now threatens bridge access.
Work a repair shift to earn bridge credit before a bond review.
Protect or challenge a witness tied to a suspected forged echo.
conflict_hooks: A courier consortium offers fast delivery only to households that sign exclusive custody terms, forcing upper-ledge families to choose between mobility and control of their promises.
Forged echoes implicate a bridge-repair fund in coercive vows; exposing the forgery may freeze credit and chain an already fragile crossing.
Weighhouse clerks schedule a public mass reweighing after tax arrears surge, while merchants pressure them to accept discounted vows as payment.
A sheltered witness can clear several debtors, but the testimony would expose a courier's broken custody chain and trigger claims against many delayed bundles.

open_action_examples.action_name: Offer a meal-vow in exchange for a courier's priority slot
open_action_examples.situation: A household's sealed promise bundle will mature before the next safe crossing.
coordinator_checks: Verify both parties can consent and the target controls route priority.
Confirm the offered meal-vow has a specific duration, recipient, and weight estimate.
Check that priority does not violate an existing emergency or court-ordered route assignment.
Record whether the arrangement creates a limited priority status rather than transferring public route authority.

open_action_examples.situation: A frightened witness agrees to appear only if their location remains protected until the hearing ends.
coordinator_checks: Confirm the Keeper has authority and material means to issue a shelter token.
Bound the token to one named witness, one hearing, and a clear expiry.
Ensure no token claims to erase lawful court access or override a protection order.
Obtain witness consent before recording protected status.

open_action_examples.action_name: Exchange half a bridge-credit claim for repair labor
open_action_examples.situation: A damaged signal line threatens closure of a crossing used by both parties.
coordinator_checks: Verify ownership, amount, and encumbrances of the bridge-credit claim.
Confirm the Stitcher accepts the labor scope, hazard, and delivery deadline.
Check proximity and access to the damaged line before recognizing labor completion.
Limit the credit transfer to the stated fraction and prevent duplicate redemption.

open_action_examples.action_name: Declare a disputed echo temporarily unusable at a hearing
open_action_examples.situation: The recording has an unexplained splice and its original custody seal is missing.
coordinator_checks: Require a stated basis such as a missing seal, audible splice, or conflicting custody record.
Confirm the Bailiff has procedural standing in the pending matter.
Make the unusable status temporary, case-specific, and subject to review.
Notify affected speakers and preserve the recording rather than destroying it.

social_rules: Every witnessed promise accrues weight-tax until fulfilled, transferred, voided, or paid.
A stamped vow slip is presumptive evidence, but its wording may be publicly reweighed.
Bridge passage may be restricted when a household exceeds its posted safety bond.
Recorded echoes require consent or lawful court custody to be used as testimony.
Couriers must preserve sealed custody chains; a broken seal creates a rebuttable presumption of tampering.
Witnesses may seek shelter before testifying, and retaliation against sheltered witnesses taints their testimony.
Debt transfers require a named accepting bearer and a witnessed burden limit.
Collective bridge repairs can support a petition to revise a closure ruling.

default_rule.palette_notes: Use sandstone and blue-gray as clothing base, dark plum edging, brass accents, and rare pale echo detail.
default_rule.silhouette_notes: Compact 2.5-head body, broad top-down-readable cape or shawl, one role-signaling carried item.

visual_consistency_rules: Strict top-down 64x64 sprite readability; no perspective or portrait posing.
Use compact 2.5-head figures with broad capes, shawls, satchels, or harnesses.
Outline with single dark #392B32 pixel edge; reserve #DDE0BE for small echo highlights.
Limit each sprite to one dominant garment color, one secondary color, brass accents, and one clear prop.
Make role props readable from overhead: bundles, scales, keys, baskets, rope coils, cylinders, or slips.
Keep luminous echo-script as sparse pale marks, never text or labels.
Favor weathered cloth, rope, brass, sealed paper, and iron over polished luxury surfaces.

camera.scale_rule: Tile-aligned; doors, bridges, sprites, and props share fixed grid scale.

visual_canon.lighting: Warm brass glints and pale echo glow on deep blue-gray cast shadows; no directional perspective shading.
architecture: Stacked carved-sandstone terraces with cutaway roofless rooms.
Narrow suspended bridges with rope rails, chain gates, and brass bond seals.
Circular echo wells, speaking-scale plinths, and tube-routing walls.
Household balconies edged with frayed pledge ribbons and canvas awnings.
Vertical stairs, winch lifts, retaining arches, and cliff-cut cisterns.
